alice.eng: looked at canary traces from the last hour, no 5xx, tail latencies unchanged. quick smoke of a few large-context prompts — results acceptable. +1 from me, but prefer canary stay at 10% for 30m. :thumbsup:

carol.pm: ran eval set against control — quality regression <0.8% for top metrics. staging rollout looked fine. approve, but request we monitor embed similarity churn and open a fast rollback if >1.5% drift.
dan.ops: can we pin quant flags to avoid auto-quant recompile on first warmup? ops want explicit flag set in rollout config.
alice.eng: good catch @dan.ops — should be easy, I can update rollout config now.
